queries:
WITH matched AS (
    SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = s.transref
    JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref
),
pair_ratios AS (
    SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_ratio
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
pair_deviations AS (
    SELECT p.transref,
           p.tradekind,
           p.pair_ratio,
           ABS(p.pair_ratio - g.overall_ratio) AS deviation
    FROM pair_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_ratio FROM matched) AS g
),
type_means AS (
    SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS mean_deviation
    FROM pair_deviations
    GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT p.tradekind,
       AVG(p.pair_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(p.deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(p.deviation - m.mean_deviation) AS avg_excess_deviation
FROM pair_deviations AS p
JOIN type_means AS m ON p.tradekind IS m.tradekind
WHERE p.deviation > m.mean_deviation
GROUP BY p.tradekind;
